Never Paste
Student data — names, IDs, grades, attendance, anything from Skyward
Employee PII — SSNs, payroll, HR records, performance data
Credentials — passwords, API keys, tokens, logins
Anything into a PUBLISHED artifact — publishing makes it public to the internet, not just to School Tech. See the AI Acceptable Use Policy, section 6.1a
When in doubt, don't paste it.

Which Claude Mode
Chat
A blank conversation. Quick one-offs — a reword, a definition. Forgets everything after you close it.
Project
Your daily driver. Pre-loaded with STA context. The tools above are Projects — use these for real work.
Cowork
A mode you flip on in the composer — works with your files and runs scheduled jobs. File access runs on the AI Admin PC. A real step up — best if you're comfortable with technical setup.Worth trying — just expect a learning curve.
The 3-Part Ask
1 · What
The actual task
"Draft a reply to this customer complaint."
2 · Context
The real thing
Paste the actual email or error — it beats describing it.
3 · Format · optional
What you want back
"Under 3 sentences." "Formal — it's for a superintendent."
Answer Off? Stay in the Chat
Name what's wrong
"Too formal — this customer is casual. Redo the opening."
Add what you left out
"They're on the HR module, mid-year renewal."
Tighten it
"Cut it to 3 sentences." "Just the steps, no intro."
Keep going
Don't restart — correcting in the same chat works best.
